t: Lesson 6, connectors. Your instructor is Patrick Diamitani.
Let's plug Claude into the tools you already use at work.
Pasting data into a chat goes stale the moment you do it.
A connector lets Claude read live data and take real actions with your approval.
Connectors are point and click, email and calendar,
chat tools like Slack, your drives and documents,
and project tools like Asana or Jira.
Then Claude can prep your meetings, summarize threads, and update your trackers.
There are three ways Claude reaches your tools. Connectors, the point and click integrations,
MCP servers, the open standard, for databases and internal tools.
And plugins which bundle connectors with skills. That's next lesson.
Stay safe. Check what each connector can read.
Start with read only access where you can.
And approve anything that sends, posts or deletes.
Quick recap, connectors give Claude live data and real actions,
and you decide what it can reach.
Your mission, connect your calendar and ask Claude to prep tomorrow's meetings.
Claude can now reach your real work.
Next lesson, plugins. A ready-made toolkit for your role.
